title: Nightly report job occasionally duplicates rows
description: Report table sometimes has duplicate rows after the nightly job.

comments.author: Sam Ortiz
comments.body: The job retries on timeout but is not idempotent. Added a unique constraint on (report_date, customer_id) and switched to upsert.

comments.author: Sam Ortiz
comments.body: Tried deleting and re-inserting the day's rows, rejected because dashboards read during the job and would see empty data.
